components.name: Accordion
components.summary: A stacked list of titles that each open to show more content.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A small label that shows the status or category of something at a glance.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: A colored box that tells readers something important about the page or a task.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A small circle that shows who a person is, with their photo, initials or the IU trident.

components.name: Billboard
components.summary: A large image paired with a short title, description and links that spotlights one important section of your site.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: A short trail of links that shows where a page sits in your site and lets people go back up a level.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A clickable box that lets people take an action, like submitting a form, or move to the next step, like "Apply now."

components.name: Calendar tile
components.summary: A small square that shows a date at a glance, with the month, day and year stacked.

components.name: Callout
components.summary: A highlighted box that draws attention to one thing on a page, with a short title, description, picture and up to two links.

components.name: Card-default
components.summary: A clickable box that previews one page, like a resource, service or degree program, and links to it.

components.name: Card-contact
components.summary: A card that shows people how to reach an office, team or department, with the address, email, phone, website, hours and social links in one place.

components.name: Card-event
components.summary: A card that previews one event, like a lecture, open house or performance, with its date, time and place.

components.name: Card-feature
components.summary: A feature card is a large doorway to a topic, like "Types of financial aid" or "Mental health support".

components.name: Card-news
components.summary: A news card previews one story, like a research discovery, a faculty award or a campus update.

components.name: Card-profile
components.summary: A profile card introduces one person, like a faculty member, advisor or staff contact.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A checkbox lets people pick one or more options from a list, like the programs they're interested in or the topics they want emails about.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A dialog is a small window that opens over the page to ask for a decision or a few details, like confirming a deletion or saving changes before leaving a form.

components.name: Disclosure
components.summary: A disclosure is a single link that opens to show a short piece of extra information, like fine print, a definition or eligibility details.

components.name: Dropdown
components.summary: A dropdown is a short menu that opens from a button or a header link, like an account menu with "My profile" and "Sign out".

components.name: Empty state
components.summary: An empty state fills a space that has nothing in it yet, like a file upload area before anyone adds a file.

components.name: File input
components.summary: A file input lets people attach a file to a form, like a letter of recommendation, a transcript or a résumé.
